name: Larval Cave Worm Brood (Grey) AP OLD

defensiveAbilities.name: Relentless
defensiveAbilities.description: When a juvenile cave worm gains the Paralyzed, Slowed, or Stunned condition, reduce the duration by half, to a minimum of 1 round. It also recovers from penalties to its Speeds and the Immobilized condition at the end of its turn. Finally, it ignores non-magical difficult terrain and treats greater difficult terrain like difficult terrain.

defensiveAbilities.name: Shake It Off
defensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger The larval cave worm brood would be affected by a condition or adverse effect (such as Cursed Metamorphosis)

Effect The larval brood negates the triggering condition or effect. Effects from artifacts, deities, or a similarly powerful source can't be avoided in this way.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ferocious Gnaw
offensiveAbilities.description: Each foe in the larval swarm's space takes (6d6) Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Pummeling Thrash
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The larval swarm's most recent action was Ferocious Gnaw

Effect The larval swarm frantically thrashes in an effort to consume its prey. The larval swarm attempts an athletics|defense:reflex check and compares the result to the Reflex DC of each creature in its space.

Critical Success The creature falls Prone and take 4d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage.

Success The creature falls prone and takes 2d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage.
